title: Time MCP Server
summary: Give your agent the real current time and reliable time zone conversion, so it stops guessing dates, deadlines and meeting hours.
description: Language models do not know what time it is. This reference server adds get_current_time, convert_time and get_time_ago, all based on IANA zone names such as Europe/Warsaw.
Launch it with uvx, which comes with the uv tool. It has no keys and does not use the network for answers.
Pass --local-timezone in the args if the machine's own zone is wrong or you want a fixed default.
useWhen: Schedule a call across three time zones
Check what a timestamp in a log means in local time
Work out the date for a deadline two weeks from now
Write release notes with the correct current date

mcp.name: time
access: Reads the system clock and your configured time zone

example.prompt: It is 16:30 in Tokyo. What time is that in New York and in Berlin?
example.result: Asia/Tokyo 16:30 is 03:30 in America/New_York and 09:30 in Europe/Berlin on the same calendar day, with daylight saving taken into account for the current date.

faq.question: Why did it reject my zone name?
faq.answer: Names must be exact IANA keys with the right case. Europe/Warsaw works, while europe/warsaw is refused.

faq.question: What does convert_time expect?
faq.answer: A 24-hour time written HH:MM, plus an optional source and target zone. Both default to the local zone.
